guidances.libelle: Adjusted non-GAAP diluted earnings per share
guidances.citation: •Narrows 2026 total company revenue guidance to $1,085 - $1,125 million, revises Cortrophin Gel revenue guidance to $480 - $500 million and raises both adjusted non-GAAP EBITDA to $290 - $300 million, and adjusted non-GAAP diluted earnings per share to $9.37 to $9.71

ANI expects full year total company adjusted non-GAAP gross margin between 60.3% and 61.0% and anticipates between approximately 21.5 million and 21.8 million shares outstanding for the purpose of calculating full year adjusted non-GAAP diluted EPS.
